newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hudson Corp NZ has 60 pct stake in Roadmark Group.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Corp NZ has 60 pct stake in Roadmark Group.

text.p: Hudson Corporate New Zealand Ltd said late on Wednesday it had acquired a 60 percent interest in Roadmark Group Ltd.
Hudson NZ is a wholly owned subsidiary of Australian-based Hudson Corporate Pty Ltd, which is in turn a wholly owned subsidiary of Australia's Hudson Timber and Hardware Ltd.
Roadmark Group is a company formed to facilitate the repositioning and expansion of the business of the existing Roadmark group of companies, Hudson NZ said.

"Roadmark's core business is the design, manufacture and distribution of road signs, and road safety, highway engineering and traffic control products. The company has an annual turnover of NZ$16 million," Hudson NZ said.
Hudson NZ late last year said it will take a 25 percent holding in Pacific Capital Assets Ltd, the proposed parent company of the Britomart Project developer, Britomart Investments Ltd.
